title: Unexplained 10-minute delay on rescue flight off Cape Canaveral
place_text: About 130 miles off the 110 radial from Cape Canaveral, Atlantic Ocean

tellings.quote: um we were 10 minutes later than what we expected.

plain: Sometime between 1989 and 1993, a rescue flight over the Atlantic, about 130 miles out from Cape Canaveral along a set compass bearing, arrived ten minutes later than its crew expected, and nobody could explain why. Greg Rogers, a NASA doctor who says he was on the flight, tells Michels "we were 10 minutes later than what we expected." Lost time like that is the kind of detail people bring up when they wonder whether something strange happened on board.
